target_customer: AI labs and agent builders who buy computer-use evaluation data and datasets; the arena itself is free for public users who judge battles
problem: Static computer-use benchmarks such as OSWorld saturate quickly and can be overfitted. Labs lack an honest, ongoing test of their agents on real work.
business_model: Free crowdsourced arena and leaderboard, with revenue from selling computer-use datasets and evaluation data to AI labs
product_category: AI evaluation, crowdsourced benchmark and data labeling for computer-use agents

founders.name: Prateek Jannu
previous_startups: Coasty (computer-use agent, the earlier name of the company)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he invented Solo-Synth-GAN and built Coasty, claimed #1 on OSWorld at 82%.

founders.name: Nitish Kovuru
prior_employers: An unnamed company where he built enterprise sales automation agent systems
founders.background_notes: Was a TA for a graduate AI course at Purdue per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs sandboxed real computers or phones running several frontier computer-use agents side by side, plus a voting and Elo ranking system and abuse controls. Standard engineering with some hard infrastructure parts.

defensibility.rationale: The arena concept is copyable by labs or other eval startups. The only moat is accumulated human preference data and leaderboard recognition, which are not yet proven.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. The company is in the S26 batch and no incumbent response is reported.

market_need_then: Computer-use agents advanced fast in 2026 and OSWorld style scores kept saturating, so labs and buyers wanted harder, live evaluations. The YC launch post claims about 60,000 dollars in early revenue, a company claim not independently verified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct copy with playful touches, sentence case headlines and plain calls to action

rebrands.why: Dealroom notes CoArena was formerly known as Coasty; the reason is not stated and the date is approximate

brand_strength.rationale: The name echoes Chatbot Arena style arenas, which helps explain the product at once. No press or community evidence about the brand itself was found and the site is operated under the Coasty parent.

outcome_analysis: CoArena is a Summer 2026 company still active with two founders. It grew out of the Coasty computer-use agent and now runs a free crowdsourced arena that feeds a paid data business. No exit, shutdown or layoff reports exist, so it is too early to judge success or failure. The key uncertainty is whether labs will pay for the resulting data.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a 125 thousand dollar seed and CB Insights lists a 500 thousand dollar convertible note, neither with investors or a confirmed date, and both are aggregators. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found, so the list is empty. The coarena.ai site was reported as pausing new tasks in one search summary, unconfirmed. Outcome searches found no acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports.
